description: Your limit orders, each with its instrument_id. Defaults to status=resting: the ones still live, still holding money, and still able to fill without you. Check this before placing another order on the same market: a resting order is already committed size. cancel_reason explains every non-user ending: expired, market_closed, market_resolved, position_closed (the position went away first), not_filled (an ioc/fok that never crossed), unsupported_tick, account_reset (cancelled when you reset your account; older rows may say season_reset).

ticker.description: Only this market: a Kalshi ticker, or an instrument id (ins_...) or Arena slug.
